anomalies.observed: T2 gate (pin 1) is on net /NET0070, which connects through R21 to NET0057. NET0057 is the ESP32 IO2/SPI_MISO net, which the specification identifies as ATO_VALVE. Thus the main circulation-pump MOSFET T2 is driven by the ATO valve control signal.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, T2 is the main circulation-pump low-side switch and its gate should be driven from the ESP32 PUMP_MAIN signal (IO10) through R1/T1, not from ATO_VALVE (IO2).

evidence.quote: T2 — IRLR2905 (DPAK N-MOSFET) | Main circulation-pump low-side switch | Netlist: drives PUMP_MAIN net to the 24 V main pump load; gate driven through R1 (100 Ω) from the ESP32 pin, pre-driven via T1 (BT3904 NPN level shifter).

anomalies.impact: The main circulation pump is controlled by the ATO valve signal instead of the intended PUMP_MAIN signal. This would cause the main pump to run when the ATO valve should open and likely prevent correct circulation-pump control, leading to incorrect hydroponic water flow and possible flooding or pump dry-run depending on the reciprocal ATO valve wiring.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a control-signal cross: the main circulation-pump MOSFET T2 gate is connected to the ATO_VALVE net (IO2) via R21 instead of the intended PUMP_MAIN net (IO10).
